sentences.text: After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the applicant/petitioner confines his prayer to file bail application before the learned trial court which may be decided in accordance with the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil versus Central Bureau of Investigation and another;(2021) 10 SCC 773.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil versus Central Bureau of Investigation and another;(2021) 10 SCC 773
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant/petitioner.

On due consideration of the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, it is provided that in case, the applicant/petitioner moves bail application before the trial court within fifteen days' from today, the same shall be decided within a period of two weeks thereafter in accordance with the law laid down in the case of Satender Kumar Antil versus Central Bureau of Investigation and another (supra).
With the aforesaid, the application/petition is disposed of..
